name: Training & Fine-tuning Data Poisoning
description: Malicious or unauthorised examples introduced into training, fine-tuning or feedback data so the resulting model carries biased behaviour or a backdoor trigger.
differs: Distinguished from Retrieval/RAG Poisoning (T2.001) and Persistent Memory Poisoning (T2.002) by the surface: the corruption is baked into model weights at training time, not into retrievable content or agent memory.
